These grayscale PNGs are crops of a photographed LAZ parking sign displayed on
a phone and captured by the road camera. They preserve the original circular
finder patterns, central logo, blur, and exposure. No QR modules were generated,
reconstructed, or replaced. The crops contain only the public parking QR and its
border; surrounding people, screens, and account information are excluded.

The encoded public URL is `https://clip.lazparking.com/p/143245`. Tests re-encode
the lossless crops as grayscale JPEG using OpenCV at the device's quality of 98.
Full camera-frame validation also uses the device's actual Pillow encoder.
